profile.headline: Energy Management & Building Automation Leader | EMS/BAS Optimization, Andover SME, HVAC Controls & Enterprise Energy Performance; Project Management | Training
profile.summary:
Senior energy management and building automation professional with extensive experience optimizing EMS/BAS performance, reducing downtime, and lowering operating costs across large retail and logistics portfolios. Recognized subject matter expert on Andover platforms and HVAC controls, with a track record of stabilizing enterprise systems, improving comfort, and delivering measurable energy savings.

Skilled in EMS programming, database administration, and troubleshooting complex networking and controls issues across geographically dispersed facilities. Known for building strong partnerships with operations, IT, vendors, and field teams to implement energy strategies, standardize processes, and drive continuous improvement.

Key strengths include enterprise EMS support, energy analysis and audits, preventive maintenance strategies, alarm design, project management, and team training/mentoring. Passionate about creating resilient, efficient building systems and supporting organizations in meeting energy reduction and sustainability goals.

| Strategic planning | team leadership | system evaluation | EMS software programming | all things Andover | energy audit | energy analysis | energy reduction | sustainability | training |

positions.title: Building Automation Controls Engineer
positions.description:
Macy’s and Bloomingdale's is a premier US omni-channel fashion retailer with a large portfolio of department stores and logistics facilities.

Responsibilities:

• Serve as corporate-level building automation energy engineer and subject matter expert for Andover EMS systems across Macy’s, Bloomingdale’s, Backstage, and multiple logistics locations nationwide.

• Administer the Andover Enterprise Database and provide high-level support for webClient and workstation servers used by call center and field teams.

• Monitor and analyze EMS operations to identify abnormal usage, improve system reliability, and drive energy savings across all regions.

• Collaborate with system and technology teams to resolve networking and IP infrastructure issues affecting EMS performance.

• Project-manage EMS system upgrades, software changes, and security patch deployments with minimal disruption to operations.

• Lead weekly energy calls for all U.S. regions, highlighting high-usage locations, identifying root causes, and coordinating corrective actions.

Key achievements:

• Reduced emergency service calls by more than 10% annually for three consecutive years through preventive strategies and improved troubleshooting.

• Served as subject matter expert during re-commissioning projects, helping deliver 10–15% energy savings at multiple locations.

• Trained facilities and HVAC teams on EMS hardware, streamlining problem-solving and reducing downtime.

• Standardized EMS software to improve scan times and accelerate input/output control, while creating user-friendly graphics that made troubleshooting faster for end users.

• Recognized by project leadership for managing a Florida EMS Upgrade Project that successfully upgraded 55 systems in roughly seven months, coordinating contractors, store teams, and call center turnover.

positions.title: Manager of Utility Services/Building Technology
positions.description:
Managed EMS and utility-related building technology for a multi-site retail portfolio across Florida and Puerto Rico.

Responsibilities:

• Maintained and optimized EMS for 62 locations, focusing on cost-efficient energy strategies for lighting and HVAC equipment.

• Directed troubleshooting and repair of EMS hardware and software, coordinating with vendors and facilities teams.

• Developed and standardized preventive maintenance procedures, including dark-store and high-temperature alarms, to improve system reliability and response times.

• Supervised a team of eight HVAC technicians and one electrician (2004–2009), providing technical leadership, coaching, and performance oversight.

Key achievements:

• Reduced emergency service calls by more than 10% annually for three consecutive years through preventive strategies and improved troubleshooting.

• Served as subject matter expert during re-commissioning projects, helping deliver 10–15% energy savings at multiple locations.

• Trained facilities and HVAC teams on EMS hardware, streamlining problem-solving and reducing downtime.

• Standardized EMS software to improve scan times and accelerate input/output control, while creating user-friendly graphics that made troubleshooting faster for end users.

• Recognized by project leadership for managing a Florida EMS Upgrade Project that successfully upgraded 55 systems in roughly seven months, coordinating contractors, store teams, and call center turnover.

positions.title: Controls System Programmer - Tampa, FL
positions.description:
I transferred from Corporate to fulfill the needs of the branch office by programming microprocessor based energy management systems. These systems controlled lighting, card access security systems, digital video security, HVAC, and fuel tank monitoring.
        
The position required working as part of a team in planning, system design, job coordination, and implementation of projects. The System Development Life Cycle (SDLC) was utilized to develop
software for automation systems.

I developed graphical interfaces for end-users and performed in-depth training for various skill levels.

positions.title: Controls System Programmer - Youngstown, OH
positions.description: My responsibilities focused on troubleshooting and programming Andover and Honeywell control systems for various HVAC and lighting systems.  I assisted technicians with programming and troubleshooting network communication problems.  Customer-requested software changes, including retail chains with 300+ locations, were fulfilled. Training new programmers on software installations and protocol was also part of my responsibility.

positions.title: HVAC Service Division - Various
positions.description: I worked in various roles in the HVAC Service Division including a promotion resulting in managing (14) HVAC service technicians in (4) regions within Ohio and Pennsylvania.
